notes: Typing / in a Codex conversation now offers /btw too, and picking it types /btw, ready for your question. Before, it was only suggested in Claude conversations, though typing it in full already worked in both.

Two ways off a conversation, now on Claude and Codex. Side chat asks a quick question about the conversation: nothing is saved and nothing changes. Branch starts a new saved conversation that carries on from here with everything so far, and can do work on its own while the original stays as it is; it shows in your list as a branch, with a link back. Both buttons explain themselves when you hover over them, Conversation options describes each, and each one points to the other. Requested by Brad.

On a computer, the Side chat button now sits in the row under the message box, next to Add project and Add task, labelled Side chat, and shows as pressed while the side chat is open; it is also there, as an icon, while Claude is working. Phones keep the speech-bubble button in the conversation's header. Suggested by Brad.

The cost under each reply, and in its Ready notification, is that reply's own cost again. A conversation keeps one Claude process across replies, and Claude reports that process's running total, so in a long conversation each later reply showed what all the earlier ones cost too. Found while building side chat.

Side chat: ask about a conversation without adding to it. Open it with the speech-bubble button in the conversation's header, Side chat in Conversation options, Ctrl+; or by starting a message with /btw. It starts from the conversation as it is, can read files and search the web but cannot change anything, saves nothing, and shows what each answer cost. On a wide window it sits in the right-hand panel beside Results, Queue and Git; on a phone it opens as a sheet. Claude conversations only for now. Requested by Brad.

Inbox Watch: resolving an entry in Pocket closes its story again. Pocket reported a resolve as "resolved" and the watcher only listened for "resolve", so since Oct 19 your resolves cleared the list but the watcher kept following the story and could treat it as still open. Reported by Brad.
